reports.text: CEB notice: planned power interruption in Gampaha tomorrow 09:00-15:00 for line maintenance.
Call centre: 18 customers around Veyangoda say data is very slow and calls keep dropping.
Social media post: "heard the Padukka tower is already fixed, the company van came" (unconfirmed).
NMS 06:00 | MAJOR | BER87 Beruwala | AC MAINS FAIL, running on battery bank
NMS 06:00 | MAJOR | PAD85 | rectifier input lost (mains), DC on batteries
NMS 06:00 | CRITICAL | transmission HOM12->PAD85 | fibre/MW path down, no sync

finding.finding: Verified faults are grid-power loss at S01 (Beruwala) and S09 (Padukka), plus down backhaul link L09 (Homagama–Padukka). Equipment status at both power-fault sites is not established by these reports; other asset conditions remain as supplied in the sparse observed state. No action is deferred: the evidence identifies no unsafe or impossible work, and uncertainty is not grounds to hold actions. The catalogue provides equipment repairs and a single generator deployment, but no repair action for grid power or L09 backhaul; crews list equipment and generator skills, not backhaul skill. Approved V

findings: The three extracted facts match their cited authoritative snapshots and directory targets: S01 is Beruwala/BER87 with AC mains failure; S09 is Padukka/PAD85 with mains input lost; L09 is the HOM12-to-PAD85 path, from S08 Homagama to S09 Padukka, reported down.
The ignored Veyangoda complaint, future Gampaha utility notice, and unconfirmed Padukka social-media claim are correctly not treated as verified asset facts.

The planned generator deployment targets S01, and arithmetic checks: travel from DEPOT to S01 is 5 minutes, work starts at minute 5, and 10 minutes of work ends at minute 15. No evidence makes this action unsafe. The remaining needs are explicitly left unmet rather than represented as resolved.
